 Jason Statham's 2026 action thriller Mutiny is coming to streaming platforms very soon.

 After its summer theatrical release, Mutiny earned mixed reviews from critics and a 49% on Rotten Tomatoes, though audiences were much more receptive, giving it an 85%. At the box office, the action thriller debuted in sixth place on opening weekend and grossed $30 million by the time it left theaters.
 Despite being a theatrical flop, moviegoers who weren't willing to pay for a ticket will soon be able to watch Mutiny from home. Starz 's website reveals that it will stream on its platform in the U.S. beginning in December, though an exact date hasn't been announced yet. The action thriller was already released on digital platforms back in early September, and it came out on Blu-ray and DVD on November 3.
 Statham stars in Mutiny as Cole Reed , a former U.S. Marine who's hired as a bodyguard for a billionaire. After being accused of killing his boss, Cole hides out on a cargo ship as part of his mission to uncover the truth about the murder, but he ends up discovering a vast conspiracy while out at sea.

 Statham's co-stars in the movie are Annabelle Wallis, Adrian Lester, Jason Wong, Roland Møller, Arnas Fedaravicius, Ramon Tikaram, Simon Kluth and Chaneil Kular. Jean-François Richet, who previously helmed 2023's Plane and Netflix's upcoming French-language film The Hunchback, Soul of Paris , directed Mutiny from a script by Lindsay Michel and J.P. Davis.
 When Lionsgate released Mutiny on digital platforms two months ago, it quickly surged to the top of the charts, suggesting fans of Statham and the action-thriller genre wanted to see the film but not enough to head to a movie theater.
 Once Mutiny is released on Starz, the flick could find success again. This achievement came after Mutiny was accidentally leaked on Prime Video, which could have contributed to low ticket sales.

 Mutiny is the second movie that Statham has starred in this year, following Shelter , which came out back in January. Over the years, the actor has appeared in films like Lock, Stock and Two Smoking Barrels , Snatch , The Italian Job , Spy and The Meg , as well as several major franchises, including Transporter , The Expendables and Fast & Furious .
 In 2024, Statham starred in the hit action thriller The Beekeeper as Adam Clay, a role he will reprise on January 15 for the sequel. He will follow up Mutiny and The Beekeeper 2 by playing himself in the comedy Jason Statham Stole My Bike next August.
